title: Blue competence and red excitement in brand personality
statement:
Blue is mapped to competence and red to excitement in brand personality dimensions, allowing strategic color choice to shape perceived brand traits.

Options:
- Competent blue: #0000CD medium blue (fits: trust, professional)
- Exciting red: #FF0000 pure red (fits: energetic, attention)
- Sophisticated purple: #4B0082 indigo (fits: premium, innovative)
- Sincere green: #228B22 forest green (fits: growth, health)
appliesWhen: Applies to: fintech, luxury, health. Audience: adults, b2b buyers, general.

source.title: Exciting red and competent blue: the importance of color in marketing
source.authors: Lauren I. Labrecque; George R. Milne
source.venue: Journal of the Academy of Marketing Science
